sources.title: Qwen3.5-2B: Specifications and GPU VRAM Requirements
sources.snippet: About Qwen3.5-2B Qwen3.5-2B is Alibaba Cloud's small-scale multimodal foundation model with 2B parameters, released February 2026. It uses a hybrid architecture combining Gated Delta Networks and Gated Attention in a 6× (3×DeltaNet→FFN→1×Attention→FFN) pattern.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-2B - Qualcomm AI Hub
sources.snippet: Balanced 2B parameter model from the Qwen3.5 series for on‑device inference. Qwen3.5 is the latest multilingual language model series from Alibaba Cloud with improved reasoning and instruction‑following capabilities over Qwen3.
